blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Post-training INT8 quantization is typically validated by checking accuracy retention, which requires ground-truth labels often unavailable in low-resource clinical settings. We show a label-free alternative: comparing a model's own output before and after quantization. We compute cosine similarity between the FP32 and INT8 models' output probability vectors for each prediction, which requires only a single forward pass. This output-agreement similarity separates lower-accuracy predictions across four evaluated architectures (ResNet-50, VGG-16-BN, Wide ResNet-50, and ViT-B/16) under fixed-percentile splits, outperforming a confidence-only baseline for all four. These results show that quantized models can be compared to their baselines to assess their drift and determine whether they are well suited for clinical deployment.
blocks.zh: 训练后INT8量化一般通过检查准确性保留来验证,这需要地面真实的标签,在低资源临床环境中往往没有. 我们显示一个无标签的替代品:比较一个模型在被分解前后自己的输出. 我们计算每一次预测的FP32和INT8模型的输出概率向量的同心圆相近性,这只需要一次前行通过. 这种产出-协议相似性将四个评价架构(ResNet-50、VGG-16-BN、Wide ResNet-50和ViT-B/16)的低准确度预测在固定百分率分数下区分开来,这比所有四个架构的只有信任的基准要差。 这些结果表明,可以将量化模型与其基线进行比较,以评估其漂移情况,并确定它们是否适合临床应用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Model compression techniques such as quantization reduce memory requirements and energy consumption, allowing models to run on less capable hardware. This is especially relevant for edge deployment in low-resource settings, which are becoming further constrained by the rising cost of hardware [ 14 ] and the growing requirements of deep learning (DL) models. Clinical settings are commonly resource constrained, outside of highly specialized and high-tier hospitals, and commonly require using post-training quantization [ 8 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 量化等模型压缩技术会降低内存要求和能耗,使模型能运行在能力较差的硬件上. 这对于在低资源环境下的边缘部署尤为重要,由于硬件成本的上升[14]和对深层学习(DL)模型的日益增长的需要,这些环境正进一步受到制约. 临床环境通常受资源限制,在高度专业化和高水平的医院之外,通常需要使用培训后量化[8,11]。

blocks.en: However, while quantized models often perform at or below the baseline set by their non-quantized counterparts, especially strong quantization such as INT8 and INT4 [ 9 ] , the size of this gap is often unknown and varies per model and setting. Understanding this gap is important for clinical deployment, but doing so usually requires labeled test data, which can be difficult to obtain for medical applications. Expert annotation are often required, which is expensive and time consuming, particularly for segmentation tasks, and such annotations are frequently unavailable in low-resource settings.
blocks.zh: 然而,虽然被量化的模型往往表现在或低于其非被量化的对应方设定的基准,特别是强烈的被量化如INT8和INT4[9]等,但这种差距的大小往往未知,而且每个模型和设置也各不相同. 理解这一差距对于临床部署很重要,但这样做通常需要贴有标签的测试数据,对于医疗应用来说可能很难获得. 往往需要专家说明,因为专家说明费用昂贵,而且耗费时间,特别是分门别类的任务,在资源匮乏的情况下往往得不到这种说明。

blocks.en: In this work, we show that for a mammography dataset [ 7 ] we can leverage the models own output before and after quantization to identify when the quantized model drifts too far from the non-quantized model leading to less reliable predictions. This can alleviate the need for annotated data and help clinicians understand if the quantized models meets their deployment needs without having to annotate any additional data.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们显示,对于一个乳房X光学数据集[7],我们可以利用模型在定量前后自有的输出来识别被定量模型漂移到离非定量模型太远时,导致预测的可靠性更低. 这可以减轻对附加说明的数据的需求,并帮助临床医生了解量化模型是否满足其部署需要,而无需说明任何其他数据。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1) Exploring the impact of quantization of three different convolution based models (ResNet-50, VGG-16-BN, and Wide ResNet-50) and a transformer based model (ViT-B/16) on the publicly available mammography dataset CBIS-DDSM for cancer detection 2) Using cosine similarity of the models output for failure case detection using the available test data, 3) Demonstration that this method works across different architectures, and seeds.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 1) 探索将三种不同的以演化为基础的模型(ResNet-50、VGG-16-BN和Wide ResNet-50)和以变压器为基础的模型(ViT-B/16)量化对公开提供的乳房X光照相数据集CBIS-DDSM癌症检测的影响 2) 利用现有测试数据对故障案例检测模型输出的同位素相近性,3) 证明这种方法在不同的架构和种子之间起作用。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Quant-XAI [ 6 ] introduced “explainability drift,” relying on ground-truth evaluation and a fake-quantization proxy; we extend this with a backprop-free, label-free per-case signal on the true converted model. Catalan-Tatjer et al. [ 1 ] showed LLM quantization robustness is governed by training dynamics. Saliency-guided QAT [ 10 ] intervenes during training instead. Cross-model disagreement is a recognized label-free signal elsewhere [ 2 , 4 , 12 ] ; we extend this to quantization, across architectures.
blocks.zh: Quant-XAI [6] 采用了“可解释性漂移,”依靠地面真实评估和假量化代用;我们在真实的转换模型上,用无背道口、无标签的每例信号加以扩展。 加泰罗尼亚-塔特杰尔等. [1] 显示LLM量化稳健性受培训动态的制约. 在训练期间,有显著指导的QAT[10]进行干预。 跨模型分歧是其他地方公认的无标签信号 [2, 4, 12];我们将此延伸至量化,跨建筑.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Dataset. We use CBIS-DDSM [ 7 ] , a curated mammography dataset with radiologist-annotated tumor masks, for binary classification of each breast mass or calcification as malignant or benign . We construct a patient-grouped split using the official train/test designation, removing 31 patients appearing in both splits, yielding 2,780 training images (2,417 train / 363 validation) and 704 held-out test images. Of these, 384 have an available ROI mask and are used for experimental analyses; classification metrics use the full 704.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们使用CBIS-DDSM [7],一个带有放射学家附加说明的肿瘤口罩的乳腺造影数据集,将每个乳房质量或钙化分为恶性或良性. 我们利用正式的列车/测试指定来构建一个病人分组的分机,移除了这两次分机中出现的31个病人,生成了2 780个训练图像(2 417个列车/363个验证)和704个被搁置的测试图像。 其中384个有ROI口罩,用于实验分析;分类计量标准使用完整的704个.

blocks.en: Model, training, and quantization. We train and evaluate ResNet-50 [ 5 ] , VGG-16-BN [ 13 ] , Wide ResNet-50 [ 15 ] , and ViT-B/16 [ 3 ] . All models are pre-trained on ImageNet-1K, with a randomly initialized four-layer classification head added for the final malignant-vs-benign prediction. To reduce overfitting, we freeze the earliest layers of each backbone: conv1 , bn1 , layer1 , and layer2 for ResNet-50 and Wide ResNet-50; the first 13 convolutional layers for VGG-16-BN; and the patch embedding together with the earliest transformer encoder blocks for ViT-B/16. We apply post-training static INT8 quantization via PyTorch’s FX graph API ( qnnpack backend, 500 calibration images), using the fully converted INT8 model for all reported results. Full training hyperparameters are reported in Appendix A . All four architectures undergo the same per-case statistical analysis in Sections 4.2 – 4.3 ; ViT-B/16’s per-bin trend is reported separately in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 模范、培训和量化。 我们训练和评价ResNet-50 [5],VGG-16-BN [13],Wide ResNet-50 [15],和Vit-B/16 [3]。 所有模型在ImageNet-1K上都经过了预先的训练,为最终的恶性-vs-benign预测增加了随机初始化的四层分类头. 为了减少过度调整,我们冻结了每个主干管的最早的地层:Conv1,bn1,层1,和地层2,用于ResNet-50和Wide ResNet-50;第一个为VGG-16-BN的13个分层;以及与最早为VIT-B/16的变压器编码器块一起嵌入的补丁. 我们通过 PyTorch 的 FX 图 API (qnnpack 后端, 500 校正图像) 应用训练后静态INT8 量子化,对所有报告结果使用完全转换的INT8 模型. 完整的训练超参数在附录A中报告。 所有四个架构在4.2至4.3节中都经过同样的个案统计分析;VIT-B/16的每期趋势在附录B中单独报告。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 FP32 and INT8 Performance
blocks.zh: 4.1 FP32和INT8 性能

blocks.en: Evaluating FP32 vs. fully converted INT8 ResNet-50 across 3 seeds ( n = 1,152 n=1{,}152 ): accuracy drops from 73.0 % 73.0\% to 66.5 % 66.5\% ( − 6.5 -6.5 pts). Aggregate checks alone may miss sample-level performance drops.
blocks.zh: 评价FP32对完全转换为INT8 ResNet-50的3个种子(n=1,152n=1{,}152):精度由73.0% 73.0\%降至66.5% 66.5\%(-6.5-6.5 pts). 单是综合检查就可能错过样本级的性能下降.

blocks.en: Table 1 reports the aggregate FP32-vs-INT8 comparison (Accuracy, AUC, F1) for all four architectures. FP32 baselines are close across all architectures (ResNet-50: 73.0, VGG-16-BN: 72.4, ViT-B/16: 71.7, Wide ResNet-50: 69.5), with standard deviation overlapping across all models. The impact of INT8 quantization varies per model: ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16 drop about 6% in accuracy, while VGG-16-BN and Wide ResNet-50 show only a 1%–2% decrease. AUC drops are architecture dependent rather than uniform: 2% for VGG-16-BN, 5% for ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16, and 8% for Wide ResNet-50. F1 score drops substantially for ViT-B/16 and Wide ResNet-50 specifically, suggesting these two models would benefit from recalibration after quantization.
blocks.zh: 表1报告所有四种建筑的FP32-vs-INT8总比较(准确性、AUC、F1)。 FP32基线在所有架构中相距相近(ResNet-50:73.0,VGG-16-BN:72.4,VIT-B/16:71.7,Wide ResNet-50:69.5),所有模型的标准偏差相重叠. INT8的四分法的影响因模型而异:ResNet-50和Vit-B/16的准确度下降约6%,而VGG-16-BN和Wide ResNet-50则仅显示1%–-2%的下降. AUC的投放是架构依赖而非统一:VGG-16-BN为2%,ResNet-50和Vit-B/16为5%,而Wide ResNet-50为8%. VIT-B/16和Wide ResNet-50的分数大幅下降,具体表明这两种模式在被量化后将受益于再调整。

blocks.en: 4.2 Output Disagreement
blocks.zh: 4.2 产出分歧

blocks.en: Stratification by output similarity is significant for all four architectures at threshold 0.8 (predictions pooled across all 3 seeds, n = 1,152 n=1{,}152 per architecture): ResNet-50 ( n = 123 n=123 , 30.1 % 30.1\% vs. 70.8 % 70.8\% ), VGG-16-BN ( n = 56 n=56 , 28.6 % 28.6\% vs. 72.4 % 72.4\% ), Wide ResNet-50 ( n = 211 n=211 , 44.5 % 44.5\% vs. 73.9 % 73.9\% ), ViT-B/16 ( n = 114 n=114 , 26.3 % 26.3\% vs. 69.6 % 69.6\% ).

Figure 1 shows this per seed before pooling: accuracy binned by similarity within each seed, then averaged. ResNet-50’s 4 bins all contain data from all 3 seeds and follow a monotonic trend ( 30.7 % ± 8.6 % 30.7\%\pm 8.6\% lowest bin vs. 73.7 % ± 1.5 % 73.7\%\pm 1.5\% highest); Wide ResNet-50, VGG-16-BN, and ViT-B/16 follow a similar trend with more per-seed noise in intermediate bins.
blocks.zh: 图1在集合前显示每个种子的这个:精度被每个种子内部的相似性所同化,再被平均. ResNet-50的4个垃圾箱都包含来自所有3个种子的数据,并遵循了单一化趋势(30.7% ± 8.6 % 30.7\%\pm 8.6\% 最小垃圾箱对73.7% ± 1.5\%\pm 1.5\%;Wide ResNet-50,VGG-16-BN,和Vit-B/16 遵循了类似趋势,中间垃圾箱中每种子的噪音较多.

blocks.en: Per-seed threshold sensitivity confirms this holds for all four architectures in every seed at threshold 0.8 (Appendix D ), though VGG-16-BN’s smallest seed (1207, n = 4 n=4 ) and ViT-B/16’s smallest seed (1207, n = 4 n=4 ) both reflect a genuinely lower baseline disagreement rate under static quantization relative to the other architectures.
blocks.zh: 被种子阈值灵敏度证实了在0.8阈值(附录D)时每个种子中所有四个架构的这种坚持,尽管VGG-16-BN最小的种子(1207,n = 4 n = 4)和VIT-B/16最小的种子(1207,n = 4 n = 4)都反映了相对于其他架构的静态分解下真正较低的基线分歧率.

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison to a Confidence-Only Baseline
blocks.zh: 4.3 与仅信任基线的比较

blocks.en: Output disagreement costs more to compute than confidence: it needs the original FP32 model plus two forward passes per image (one FP32, one INT8), while confidence comes from the INT8 model’s own output. We explore if this can be used a signal as well as decribed in Section 3 . Table 4 (Appendix C ) reports the result: Output disagreement separates accurate from inaccurate predictions more effectively than confidence, for all four architectures.
blocks.zh: 输出分歧的成本比起信心更需要计算:它需要原始的FP32模型外加每幅图像的两张前传(一幅FP32,一幅INT8),而信心则出自INT8模型自己的输出. 我们探索是否可以使用信号以及第3节的破译。 表4(附录C)报告结果: 产出分歧将准确的预测与不准确的预测区分开来,比信心更有效,对于所有四种架构都是如此.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: We trained three convolutional architectures and one transformer-based architecture, and found that output cosine similarity correlates with accuracy degradation under INT8 quantization. In particular, below a threshold of 0.8, every architecture’s performance fell below that of the baseline model. This suggests that as the outputs drift away from the baseline FP32 model, classification becomes less reliable. In a real-world setting without labels, this method could potentially serve as an uncertainty: providing clinicians with the percentage of samples that fall below this threshold, and letting them decide whether that level of uncertainty is acceptable for the given application before deployment. Future work will focus on exploring whether this signal holds for other datasets, as this paper has focused only on mammography data. Additionally, we will work toward improving the separation of cases where the FP32 model and its quantized counterpart disagree, thereby increasing confidence that a quantized model is making a mistake past a certain threshold and providing clinicians with a better label-free metric. Lastly, we will explore leveraging these unreliable cases to aid in training and improve accuracy for quantized models.
blocks.zh: 我们训练了三所革命建筑和一所以变压器为基础的建筑,发现在INT8量化法下,输出同同精度降解有关。 特别是,在0.8的门槛以下,每个建筑的性能都低于基线模型。 这表明,随着产出偏离基线FP32模式,分类的可靠性降低。 在没有标签的现实世界环境中,这种方法可能成为一种不确定性:向临床医生提供低于这一阈值的样本百分比,并让他们在部署之前决定该不确定性水平是否可以接受。 今后的工作将侧重于探讨这一信号是否为其他数据集所持有,因为本文仅侧重于乳房X光学数据。 此外,我们将努力改善FP32模式与其量化对应方有不同意见的个案的分离,从而增强信心,相信量化模式正在犯出错,超越某一门槛,为临床医生提供更好的无标签衡量标准。 最后,我们将探讨利用这些不可靠的案例来帮助进行培训,并改进量化模型的准确性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we investigated output cosine similarity as a label-free signal for detecting accuracy degradation under INT8 quantization, evaluating three convolutional architectures and one transformer-based architecture on mammography data. We show that this similarity correlates with accuracy degradation relative to the FP32 baseline.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们调查了输出同位素相似性,作为在INT8分解下检测精度降解的无标签信号,在乳腺光学数据上评价了三个分解结构和一个变压器结构. 我们显示,这种相似性与FP32基准的准确性退化有关。

blocks.en: Appendix A Full Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: 附录A 全高参数

blocks.en: A.1 Training Details
blocks.zh: A.1 培训细节

blocks.en: The results reported in this paper use a single-stage (capacity-clamped) fine-tuning regimen on the CBIS-DDSM dataset [ 7 ] , trained on ResNet-50 [ 5 ] , VGG-16-BN [ 13 ] , Wide ResNet-50-2 [ 15 ] , and ViT-B/16 [ 3 ] . All models are initialized from ImageNet-1K pretrained weights. Table 2 summarizes the core training hyperparameters; architecture-specific adaptations follow below.
blocks.zh: 本文件所汇报的结果采用了CBIS-DDSM数据集的单相(容量申报)微调系统[7],经过ResNet-50[5]、VGG-16-BN[13]、Wide ResNet-50-2[15]和VIT-B/16[3]的培训。 所有模型均从ImageNet-1K预训重量初始化. 表2汇总了核心培训超参数;以下是针对建筑的调整。

blocks.en: Table 2: Training hyperparameters for the single-stage fine-tuning regimen.
blocks.zh: 表2:单相微调装置的培训超参数。

blocks.en: A.1.1 Training Regimen
blocks.zh: A.1.1 培训制度

blocks.en: The earliest backbone layers of each architecture are frozen for the entire training run, while subsequent layers and the classification head train jointly at a single fixed learning rate; the specific frozen layers per architecture are given in Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 每个建筑的最早的骨干层被冻结用于整个训练运行,而随后的地层和分类头列车以单一固定学习速率联合进行;每个建筑的具体被冻结的地层在第3节中给出.

blocks.en: The classification head is a four-layer MLP ( 2048 → 512 → 256 → 128 → 2 2048\to 512\to 256\to 128\to 2 for ResNet-50 and Wide ResNet-50-2; analogous dimensions adapted to each backbone’s output dimensionality for VGG-16-BN and ViT-B/16) with ReLU activations and dropout ( p = 0.2 p=0.2 ) after each hidden layer.
blocks.zh: 分类头为四层MLP(2048 → 512 → 256 → 128 → 2 2048\to 512\to 256\to 128\to 2,用于ResNet-50和Wide ResNet-50-2;相类似的尺寸,适用于每个主干线的输出维度,用于VGG-16-BN和VIT-B/16),每个隐藏层后有ReLU活化和退出(p=0.2 p=0.2)。

blocks.en: A.1.2 Data and Augmentation
blocks.zh: A.1.2 数据和增强

blocks.en: Training images are resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 and enhanced with contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE; clip limit 2.0, tile grid 8 × 8 8\times 8 ) prior to augmentation. Training-time augmentation consists of random horizontal and vertical flips ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 each), random rotation ( ± 15 ∘ \pm 15^{\circ} ), and Gaussian blur (kernel size 3 × 3 3\times 3 , σ ∈ [ 0.1 , 2.0 ] \sigma\in[0.1,2.0] ), with bilinear resizing and pixel normalization (mean/std = 0.5 =0.5 ). Validation and test images receive only resizing and normalization, no augmentation is applied at evaluation time.

blocks.en: A.1.3 Statistical Significance
blocks.zh: A.1.3 统计意义

blocks.en: To assess whether observed effects reflect consistent trends across initializations, we repeat all experiments across all four architectures over 3 random seeds: 1207, 804, and 510. We report mean ± \pm standard deviation across these 3 seeds, computed per seed before pooling. Seeds control weight initialization of the classification head and data shuffling order; other sources of non-determinism are left at PyTorch defaults.
blocks.zh: 为了评估所观察到的效果是否反映了整个初始化过程中的一致趋势,我们重复了所有四个结构上的所有实验,分别是1207、804和510个随机种子。 我们报告这3个种子的标准偏差是±\pm, 在集合之前计算出每个种子。 种子控制权重初始化分类头和数据排出顺序;其他非定型源被留在了PyTorch默认.

blocks.en: A.1.4 Quantization
blocks.zh: A.1.4 量化

blocks.en: Post-training static quantization is performed using PyTorch’s FX graph mode quantization API ( prepare_fx / convert_fx ) with the qnnpack backend, targeting INT8 weights and activations. Calibration uses 500 images sampled from the training set (fixed seed 42) processed in evaluation mode to record activation statistics. qnnpack was selected as the quantization backend available in our ARM-based compute environment.
blocks.zh: 训练后静态分解使用PyTorch的FX图模式分解API(准备_fx / 转换_fx)与qnnpack后端进行,针对INT8重量和活化. 校准使用从评价模式处理的培训集(固定种子42)中抽取的500个图像来记录激活统计. qnnpack被选为我们基于ARM的计算环境中可用的量化后端.

blocks.en: A.1.5 Compute
blocks.zh: A.1.5 计算

blocks.en: Experiments were run on an Apple M4 Pro system (48 GB unified memory) using PyTorch’s MPS backend for training and CPU for INT8 quantization and evaluation. Training across 3 seeds for one architecture requires approximately 45 minutes. INT8 quantization and evaluation of a single checkpoint on the 704-image test set requires under 5 minutes on CPU. Feature-embeddings disagreement requires a single forward pass per precision per image, taking under 1 minute on CPU per seed.
blocks.zh: 实验在Apple M4 Pro系统(48 GB统一内存)上运行,使用PyTorch的MPS后端进行训练,CPU进行INT8等分化和评价. 一个建筑的3个种子的培训大约需要45分钟。 INT8在704-图像测试集上对单一检查点进行量化和评价,CPU需要不到5分钟. 特异性-嵌入式分歧要求每个图像每精度有一个单向前传,每个种子的CPU花费不到1分钟.

blocks.en: A.1.6 Feature-Embeddings Disagreement: Implementation Details
blocks.zh: A.1.6 特性 -- -- 差异:执行细节

blocks.en: For each test image and seed, we compute the softmax probability vector p ∈ ℝ 2 p\in\mathbb{R}^{2} from both the FP32 model and the true converted INT8 model, recording cosine similarity alongside predicted class and correctness.
blocks.zh: 对于每个测试图像和种子,我们都会从FP32模型和真实转换的INT8模型中计算出软max概率矢量p QQ R 2 p\in\mathb{R\2},同时记录同位素相似性与预测的类和正确性.

blocks.en: Per-seed robustness analysis. Threshold sensitivity is computed independently within each seed prior to aggregation to evaluate whether classification splits remain consistent across individual training runs.
blocks.zh: 活种子强性分析. 在汇总之前,在每个种子中独立计算阈值灵敏度,以评估各个培训阶段的分类划分是否一致。

blocks.en: Confidence baseline comparison. To compare confidence against feature-embeddings disagreement on a consistent basis, we apply an identical bottom-25th-percentile split ( n = 288 n=288 per architecture) to feature-embeddings cosine similarity.
blocks.zh: 信心基线比较。 为了在一致的基础上将信心与地物嵌入的分歧进行比较,我们对地物嵌入相近的相近性采用相同的下-25百分率分法(n=288n=288)。
